tasks.title: Execute tool actions through an optional Docker sandbox
acceptanceCriteria: Allowed tools run from fixed argv in a cached Docker image without shell interpolation.
The default container profile disables network access and privilege escalation, drops capabilities, and runs as an unprivileged user.
The default container profile makes the root filesystem read-only and enforces PID, memory, CPU, timeout, and output limits.
The provider remains optional and returns structured failures when Docker or an image is unavailable.
